name: BA (Hons) International Business Management

credential.localTitle: Bachelor of Arts (Honours) International Business Management
credential.title: BA (Hons) — awarded by Leeds Beckett University

summary: An entirely online business and management degree awarded by Leeds Beckett University and delivered through IBA, over 3–6 years. Study from any location through asynchronous work and webinars; no travel to Denmark is required. Tuition is DKK 155,000 for the full degree, regardless of citizenship; a separate application fee and books are additional.
description: The programme progresses through Certificate, Diploma and Bachelor stages. It covers business organisation, digital business, economics, financial management, marketing and human resources, ending with independent research.

structure.teachingStyle: Entirely online: mainly asynchronous Canvas discussion, supported by webinars and lecturer feedback.
structure.assessment: Teaching and examinations take place online, with a final research project.
structure.flexibility: Full-time over three years or a flexible part-time pace over up to six years; each level is completed before progressing to the next.

notes: 360 CATS / 180 ECTS. The numeric duration is the published full-time minimum; flexible study may take up to six years.
Awarding institution: Leeds Beckett University, United Kingdom. Delivery provider: IBA International Business Academy, Denmark.
